analysis.rationale: The order book of ₹288 crore in Q1 alone covers 82% of the full-year target, indicating strong demand and execution momentum. The shift from services to IP-led revenue is visible with CYBX DNA AI CyberOps cumulative orders at ₹53 crore.
analysis.summary: 63SATS Cybertech, material subsidiary of 63 Moons, reported Q1 FY27 order book of ₹288 crore, achieving 82% of FY27 target, with CYBX downloads crossing 2 million and paid subscribers at 3.25 lakh.
